historical_context.time_period: Unspecified Sa'ueia period before or apart from imperial contact
historical_context.location: A first-route packing hollow one shallow ramp below the arrival terrace of an Umbros-facing Sa'ueia breeding ground.
historical_context.summary: A mobile family prepares to receive a child and the trusted burden flower that has shared the child's nursery care. A visible alarm forces the adults to decide whether family membership is a spoken claim, a logistics plan, or a distributed obligation that can change the family's route.

public_facts.text: Sa'ueia mobile family units combine kinship, childcare, craft, defense, trade, memory, and ecological negotiation.
Breeding grounds hold communal infant care and legal continuity while most adults circulate with mobile family units.
Burden flowers can warn of host sickness or hostile conditions, but hunger, neglect, and gossip pressure can distort their displays.
The authored elaboration makes first departure a transfer of named care obligations for the child and any allied organism whose established care contract would be harmed by casual separation.

ambient_pressures.text: A family that accepts a child and companion must spend pack space, route time, mineral access, light exposure, grooming labor, and privacy judgment; ecological reputation follows performance rather than declarations.
The candle road can remember honest delay, public alarm, or concealment, but its routing response is partial ecological judgment rather than ownership of the family.
Portable care archives must transmit useful thresholds while preserving the child's bounded private memory.

groups.label: Receiving Sa'ueia mobile family
institutional_logic: Carry kin, law, care, skill, memory, and ecological standing as one small mobile unit.
material_incentives: Leave within the useful candle wave
Build enough care capacity for child and companion
internal_virtues: Privacy treated as a boundary rather than secrecy by default
internal_shames: Making one caretaker the only person who understands a dependent
prestige_markers: Multiple adults able to perform the same care
Useful archives with bounded private layers
Route changes that preserve dependents without theatrical martyrdom
taboo_triggers: Treating a child or allied organism as cargo
Claiming an ecology or companion as household property
Using an exposed host state as gossip
emotional_display_norms: Practical teasing can carry affection; promises become legible through packing, watch assignments, route choice, and who gives up capacity.
trust_defaults: Trusts repeated care and route memory more than ancestry claims or confident interpretation.
speech_register_cues: Promises attached to watches, tools, and routes

groups.label: Breeding-ground caretaker continuity
institutional_logic: Entrust children and allied care relationships only when the receiving unit can preserve continuity without capturing the commons.
internal_shames: Treating departure as proof of maturity
Dumping unresolved care on the road
prestige_markers: A handover that another caretaker can resume
Children who can state care and privacy boundaries
Dependents who return without hidden neglect
taboo_triggers: Casual separation of bonded care partners
emotional_display_norms: Warmth is ordinary; assessment remains direct because politeness cannot carry a fever threshold.
trust_defaults: Trusts demonstrated shared care, ecological witnesses, and bounded archives.

groups.label: Trusted burden-flower companion
institutional_logic: Secure a living host relationship, receive minerals, light, grooming, and travel, and remain credible enough that warnings change care.
internal_shames: Not human-shaped; social judgment is expressed as lost credibility, removal pressure, or refusal rather than an assumed verbal moral code.
prestige_markers: Warnings corroborated by later care evidence
Hosts who preserve a lineage over routes
taboo_triggers: Being treated as a decorative alarm
emotional_display_norms: Grip, leaf angle, color, seed release, and filament posture carry state without providing a complete human-readable confession.
trust_defaults: Cooperates with regular care and honest sickness; may exaggerate under hunger or high gossip value.

groups.label: Lantern-and-candle route neighborhood
institutional_logic: Spend light and route capacity on travelers whose conduct preserves the local memory, root, and fungal network.
internal_shames: Not applicable as human affect; failures appear as closed lanes, dimmed light, or withdrawn future access.
taboo_triggers: Care claims used to excuse extraction
emotional_display_norms: Amber fungal spacing and cold lantern pulses make acceptance, cost, warning, and closure spatially visible.
trust_defaults: Remembers family conduct at route scale and reprices access accordingly.
speech_register_cues: Nonverbal light, scent, pressure, brightness, and route width

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Family membership follows demonstrated shared care as well as descent; a unit that cannot spread knowledge and material burden has not completed the handover.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make family promises change pack contents, watch assignments, route timing, privacy rules, and outcomes.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A flower alarm deserves response but does not own the meaning of a child's fear, illness, memory, or consent.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Treat visible color as a care prompt whose interpretation remains bounded and contestable.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Shielding a child's private signal may be right while still costing road credit; public disclosure may buy access while harming trust.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Do not flatten privacy and ecological honesty into one virtue meter. Make the tradeoff legible in route width and relationship state.

target_self_read: Unavailable in human categories; behavior tracks attachment, hunger, light, safety, credibility, and travel
misread_patterns: Treating release as consent to permanent separation
Treating quiet color as absence of need
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep adult interpretation fallible and correctable through the child's knowledge, archives, and visible flower behavior.

target_self_read: Kin arriving to collect one of their own
A small unit able to improvise
misread_patterns: The nursery may mistake route confidence for care capacity
The family may mistake affection for completed handover
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let dry domestic friction expose the difference between loving a child and budgeting the care that child brings.

observer_read: Traffic with disclosed or concealed alarm
Potential future nutrient and route partner
target_self_read: Family protecting a private child while trying to leave on time
misread_patterns: The road can price concealment without understanding why privacy mattered
The family can experience route narrowing as moral condemnation when it may be logistics and contamination caution
likely_insults: No spoken insult; narrow lanes, dim candles, and withheld rest pockets carry the response
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Preserve ecology as an interested party without granting it full access to person-scale motives.

role_pressure_fields.summary: An adult taking responsibility for a child's first mobile circuit and for distributing the allied organism's care across the family.
obligations: Keep the child and flower distinct while honoring their bond
Spread care knowledge beyond one adult
Repair route costs created by care
failure_modes: Using public ecological witness to override the child

role_pressure_fields.summary: A child leaving communal nursery care for a first circuit with a mobile family while retaining a private relationship with a burden flower.
obligations: Carry no adult's need to make the handover look easy
failure_modes: Treating assent under route pressure as free choice

role_pressure_fields.summary: A communal caretaker who knows the child and flower's established care contract and must hand over usable knowledge without transferring ownership or raw private memory.
failure_modes: Mistaking familiarity for the child's current consent

known_context.text: Senn knows the family's pack capacity, route obligations, common burden-flower care, and the visible packing-hollow signals.

beliefs.text: Senn believes a family can change route shape to carry care, but begins with too much confidence that affection and one archive are enough.

misreads.text: Senn may treat a visible alarm as more legible than the child's chosen explanation or mistake road response for moral judgment.

must_not_know.text: Senn must not know with certainty whether the red display comes from active illness, old immune memory, separation stress, hunger, or mixed causes.

known_context.text: Oru knows Pale Mica's nursery routines and some recurring signal contexts better than the incoming family does.

beliefs.text: Oru believes Pale Mica belongs inside the child's care relationship and fears being accepted only after that relationship is made convenient.

misreads.text: Oru may read practical packing uncertainty as rejection, especially once the flower makes private stress public.

must_not_know.text: Oru cannot know the candle road's complete interpretation or future route accounting from one brightness change.

known_context.text: Talar knows the nursery care record, prior fever alarms, flower grooming sequence, and the handover standard.

beliefs.text: Talar believes care is transferred only when another person can resume it from the archive and material arrangement.

misreads.text: Talar may underweight the receiving family's route obligations because nursery continuity is the local priority.

must_not_know.text: Talar must not treat long familiarity as ownership of Oru's current private fear or final route choice.

author_only_boundaries.text: Senn, Oru, Talar, Daro, Pale Mica, this packing hollow, and this exact first departure are story-local inventions, not named vault canon.
Pale Mica's red, yellow, violet, and copper pattern meanings are local scene handles, not a complete universal burden-flower language.
The structured packing-hollow camera map supports this fixture only; it does not define every breeding ground's architecture.

open_questions.question: How much choice does a child ordinarily exercise over first-route timing, receiving family, and bonded-organism separation across different Sa'ueia regions?
open_questions.notes: The fixture gives Oru meaningful local boundaries without canonizing a continent-wide age or consent code.

open_questions.question: What durable physical formats do Sa'ueia care archives use, and how are private memory layers permissioned?
open_questions.notes: Flexible membranes and fold-closed layers remain bounded visual elaboration; recurrence should trigger a technology-owner pass.

open_questions.question: Do burden flowers recognize household membership across host transfer, or only repeated embodied care from specific individuals?
open_questions.notes: The fixture shows learned care response but does not invent a universal flower kinship category.
